name: S3 Bucket Enumeration
description: ListBuckets returns the names of every bucket in the account. Attackers do this first to see what is worth stealing or encrypting. It does not download objects; it only draws the map. In a well-run account, only backup and inventory jobs list every bucket. A new identity listing all buckets, then hitting GetObject or PutBucketEncryption, is a classic steal-or-ransom sequence.
mitigations: Rotate credentials if the actor is compromised
